nodes.statement: The network is operationally closed: it self-produces 5/5 required types (lipid, membrane_lipids, nutrient, precursor, volume); only nutrient crosses the boundary. The cell produces its own boundary. Interface closure is CLOSED (the ports cover the requirements) and semantic closure is CLOSED (every self-produced type carries non-zero flux under the fed trajectory).

nodes.label: The membrane holds the individual together against diffusion: the interior st...
nodes.statement: The membrane holds the individual together against diffusion: the interior stays 60× more concentrated than the medium with the self-produced membrane, vs 4.4× with metabolism alone. The membrane — not metabolism — is what contains.

nodes.label: Agency in service of survival: chemotactic agents climb the gradient, find fo...
nodes.statement: Agency in service of survival: chemotactic agents climb the gradient, find food, and survive (79%), while blind agents random-walk and dissolve (only 35% survive) — a 2.3× survival advantage (mean ± 0.26 across 12 seeds; 12/12 favour sensing). Without sensing, the agent cannot maintain viability.

nodes.label: Sense-making: the nutrient gradient is meaningful from the perspective of the...
nodes.statement: Sense-making: the nutrient gradient is meaningful from the perspective of the precarious identity — chemotactic agents experience 1.39× more food than blind ones. Value (food = viable) is grounded in the cell's own viability, not assigned from outside. (Interpretation: 'sense-making' is the autopoietic reading of an engineered sensing→tumble response, not a claim of cognition.)
